note: Runs are recorded only from real trials against live Qloo data. An empty runs array means no trial has been run yet — never a fabricated result. A trial is recorded only when the graph pick and at least one comparison pick both came from real runs; unavailable arms produce no trial.

trialShape.gutPick: string|null — the LLM-alone pick, when the arm was configured
trialShape.misses: array — one entry per arm whose pick differed from the graph pick
trialShape.question: string — the live-show question the arms answered
trialShape.recordedAt: ISO timestamp of the real run
trialShape.timingMs: number — verdict wall time for the run
trialShape.webPick: string|null — the LLM + generic-web-data pick, when configured
